title: AMC 10 Practice: Incircle and Cevians — Where Do They Cross?
description:
AMC 10 practice problem on the incircle of a 13-14-15 triangle and the ratio where two lines cross, solved with mass points and similar triangles. (Level 4 of 5)
Two lines cross inside a triangle's incircle. Where? Most kids grab the tempting 2 to 1, but it's a trap!
Vantee shows two ways to solve it, equal tangents with mass points and a parallel line with similar triangles, plus a 3-4-5 triangle for you to try.
